apply_steps.title: Where
apply_steps.body: Wrists, the base of the throat, behind the ears. Warm points carry the oil.

apply_steps.title: How much
apply_steps.body: These are oils, not sprays. One dab on each point is the dose; a 3 ml bottle lasts accordingly.

apply_steps.title: Do not rub
apply_steps.body: Press the points together rather than rubbing, which breaks the top notes.

product.apply_note: Every blend in the shop is alcohol-free and oil based.
